# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,

Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅

- **PR #**: 1587

- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)

- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 5
- **Additions**: +444
- **Deletions**: -82
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T16:38:30Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

- [x] ▶ dev (fa-bug-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38377942056) · started 09:41 · done 11:16 ✅
